title: finding(plugin-dashboard,app-shell): a dashboard block on a page (and the Studio preview) ignores its authored refreshIntervalSeconds — no host passes onRefresh on the SchemaRenderer page path, so no timer arms
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11093 (`Fixes #11062`), from the dev's out-of-scope findings. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; that is triage's.

## Measured (class b; probe through the real `SchemaRenderer` page path, not a browser door)

A dashboard node with `refreshIntervalSeconds` 60, both bare and inside a page region, gave:
- 1 dataset read at mount, and still 1 after 180 s of fake time;
- 0 bus events;
- no refresh button.

## The sites (read at objectui `origin/main` `873284657`)

- The registered `dashboard` component (`DashboardRenderer`, through the component registry) gets no host `onRefresh` on the page path. `PageView`'s `ConsoleActionRuntimeProvider` `onRefresh` is the action runtime's handler, not the dashboard's.
- By source read, `DashboardPreview` (the Studio preview and the design surface) and `plugin-designer`'s `DashboardEditor` (its own preview component) pass none either.
- PR objectui#11093 wired the console's own `DashboardView` only, as objectui#11062 scoped it.

Seam: `spec:DashboardSchema.refreshIntervalSeconds` → `renderer:DashboardRenderer` through the `dashboard` registration (a page block). A producer of the key on a page-held dashboard block was not verified.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

First measure whether any authored page holds a dashboard block with a period. If one does, the page path passes the same bus-declaring handler PR objectui#11093 uses (`notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })`), with no second timer. Whether the Studio preview should refresh at all is a separate question.

Dedupe: the same 1100-item corpus (down to #2231). `refreshIntervalSeconds` has 8 hits: objectui#11062 and PR objectui#11093 (the console view), and objectui#8820, objectui#11004, objectui#9736 with their PRs (the hook and the type mirror). `onRefresh` has 13 hits. None covers the page path or the preview.

Dedupe words: page dashboard block refreshIntervalSeconds onRefresh, SchemaRenderer dashboard auto-refresh page, published app page dashboard timer, DashboardPreview refresh.
